svg.aria-label: Two horizontal pipelines, ticket to ship, where width is time. Two years ago the widest block was investigate, write and test, with review after it. Now the agent block is a sliver, about an hour, and the hatched review block stretches across most of the row: one to five days of waiting.
svg.text: same pipeline, two years apart. width is time
the calendar doesn't care which part was fast.
delivery = write + wait. we spent years optimising the side that was already getting faster.
